traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Myricaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire, serrate or dentate; veins pinnate; leaves evergreen or deciduous; stipules usually absent, sometimes present; plants monoecious, polygamous or dioecious; ovary usually superior, sometimes half inferior; stems woody; flowers in spikes; perianth absent; fruit drupe; stamens (2-) 4 (-6); carpels 2.
